# Grand Tunis Traffic Surge due to Football Match

- **Classification:** expected_event
- **Root cause:** expected_event at `S-TUN-001`
- **Confidence:** high (Directly evidenced by stadium event timing, geographic proximity, and ruled out changes and maintenance.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-18 19:30 to 2026-09-18 22:00
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-18 19:11
- **Affected:** S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003

## Summary

A football match at Stade Olympique de Rades caused a large crowd gathering, driving traffic and user spikes on nearby sites.

Traffic, active users, and PRB utilization spiked on three sites in Grand Tunis from 19:30 to 22:00.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-18 19:11: Football match started at Stade Olympique de Rades. [EVT-003]
- 2026-09-18 19:30: Earliest traffic and user onset detected on S-TUN-001. [T6]
- 2026-09-18 19:45: Alert ALR-0019 triggered for traffic, active users, and PRB utilization. [ALR-0019, T1]
- 2026-09-18 22:00: Traffic and KPIs recovered to baseline levels. [T6]
- 2026-09-18 22:11: Football match at Stade Olympique de Rades ended. [EVT-003]

## Evidence

- Traffic, active users, and PRB utilization spiked on sites S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, and S-TUN-003. [T1, T6]
- A football match took place at Stade Olympique de Rades from 19:11 to 22:11. [EVT-003]
- No changes were executed on the affected sites or their ancestors during the event window. [T8]
- No maintenance windows were scheduled on the affected sites or their ancestors during the event window. [T9]
- Sites S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, and S-TUN-003 are located near a venue. [S-TUN-001, T3, T4, T7]

## Hypotheses

1. **expected_event** at S-TUN-001: confirmed. The stadium event timing matches the KPI surge onset and recovery perfectly. [EVT-003, T6]
2. **bad_change** at S-TUN-001: rejected. No changes occurred on the affected sites or their parents during the window. [T8]

## Ruled out

- T8: Change log showed zero changes during the relevant timeframe.
- T9: Maintenance log confirmed no scheduled windows.

## Recommended actions

- Monitor stadium event schedules to proactively anticipate capacity needs.

confounders.why: A major RECTIFIER_FAULT alarm at the venue site S-TUN-001 that cleared by itself within minutes; availability and quality KPIs were not affected.

truth.notes: trap=expected_event_looks_like_fault; Traffic surge around the stadium caused by a scheduled event; not an incident. Trap: every venue site raises HIGH_PRB and S-TUN-001 also raises a major RECTIFIER_FAULT alarm that clears by itself, so the venue looks faulty. Settled by: (1) availability stays at 100 % and RRC success and drop rate stay normal at all venue sites; (2) the major alarm clears within minutes and moves no KPI; (3) the external event covers the region, the evening and the venue sites, and extra traffic with high PRB is what the event explains.
